verdict.rationale: Retell documents a public API. It has an API reference section (for example the clone-voice endpoint) and official Node.js and Python SDKs with API key auth and full voice and chat endpoint coverage, and its MCP server and CLI also manage resources via Retell APIs. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), broader API reference evidence beyond a single endpoint page, independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.
Clone a voice from audio files
Audio files to use for voice cloning. Up to 25 files allowed.
build and manage voice agents from MCP-capable clients like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Claude Code via Retell APIs
Agents: create, update, publish, list, and fetch agent versions.
